raw_text: EMERGENCY: Downed live power wire sparking across the pedestrian crosswalk on 4th Street outside the community center. Children are nearby!
summary: Live sparking electrical wire on pedestrian crosswalk near community center posing imminent electrocution hazard.
recommended_action: CRITICAL: Deploy immediate hazard crew and cordon off surrounding perimeter.

raw_text: Strong sulfur and natural gas odor detected rising from storm drain grate near Elmwood commercial shops. Pedestrians feeling dizzy.
summary: Severe gas odor leaking from storm drain near commercial district causing dizziness among pedestrians.
recommended_action: Dispatch fire department hazmat and gas utility emergency response immediately.

raw_text: Brown contaminated water with metallic taste coming out of municipal faucets across 3 residential blocks on North Hill. Multiple families reporting gastrointestinal illness.
summary: Contaminated brown tap water reported across multiple blocks in North Hill linked to resident sickness.
recommended_action: Alert Department of Public Health for on-site water quality testing and issue temporary boil-water advisory.

raw_text: Deep 8-inch pothole in the eastbound lane of Grand Avenue right after the highway overpass. Blew out two car tires in under an hour.
summary: Severe 8-inch road pothole causing vehicular damage on Grand Avenue.
recommended_action: Issue high-priority work order to Department of Public Works for asphalt patching.

raw_text: The main traffic signal at the intersection of Lincoln & 8th has been completely stuck on flashing yellow since yesterday evening, causing gridlock.
summary: Malfunctioning traffic light stuck on flashing yellow creating major traffic congestion at key intersection.
recommended_action: Dispatch traffic signal technician to reset intersection controller box.

raw_text: The morning elementary school bus stop on Route 9 has no crosswalk lines or flashing beacon. Commuter cars speed through at 50mph while children wait.
summary: Unprotected school bus stop on high-speed roadway creating hazardous conditions for waiting children.
recommended_action: Coordinate with traffic safety board to install pedestrian beacons and assign morning crossing officer.

raw_text: Our community center after-school robotics club received the new STEM kits requested last month. The students are thrilled and engaged!
summary: Positive feedback celebrating the arrival and successful rollout of youth STEM robotics kits.
recommended_action: Document positive educational outcome for quarterly city community grant report.

raw_text: Ongoing illegal dumping of industrial paint buckets, old mattresses, and construction debris behind the walking trail at Willow Creek.
summary: Illegal dumping of hazardous paint and bulky construction waste contaminating nature trail.
recommended_action: Schedule environmental sanitation crew and install temporary wildlife/anti-dumping surveillance camera.

raw_text: Huge thank you to the urban forestry team for swiftly trimming back the precarious dead oak branches overhanging the public playground!
summary: Appreciation expressed for rapid preventative tree branch maintenance above public playground.
recommended_action: Log employee commendation for the Urban Forestry & Parks division.

raw_text: The online building permit portal has been returning error 504 gateway timeout for two straight days. Small business owners cannot get inspections approved.
summary: City building permit web service experiencing extended downtime preventing commercial inspection approvals.
recommended_action: Escalate portal outage to Municipal IT Infrastructure Team for immediate server restart and capacity check.

raw_text: The public budget hearing was very well organized this year with hybrid zoom options and clear translated slide decks. Great civic transparency!
summary: Citizen commendation for accessible, multilingual, and transparent public budget proceedings.
recommended_action: Maintain hybrid format and multilingual materials as standard protocol for future municipal hearings.

raw_text: The public dog park water fountains have been non-functional and stagnant water is pooling, breeding massive swarms of mosquitoes.
summary: Stagnant standing water at dog park fountain creating mosquito breeding vector.
recommended_action: Schedule vector control larvicide treatment and repair fountain drainage.
